summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.
- Run the “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” procedure in between other work, in the stated order.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.
- The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing 400 responses in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Invoice pagination is superseded/paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware caused duplicate invoices in staging.
- Removing pending usage events before successful persistence breaks retry retention.

## Plan and progress
- Rollout steps 1–6 are done. EU and APAC steps remain pending; their exact commands are unavailable, so status is unknown.
- Webhook investigation, fix, and tests are pending; no exact next command has been specified.

## Recent work
Worker retention and isolation fixes passed 118 tests; a 5,000-batch reproduction retained 2.1 MiB with zero pending events. Shared billing-filter parsing removed duplicate currency flags; 15 CLI and 22 command tests passed. The remaining duplicate currency declaration was removed and help output verified.
